title: Eleven Streets and the Whole of It
subtitle: 世界与时代 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 世界与时代（历史社会与文化·世界与时代）
meta: 主题语境：世界与时代（历史社会与文化·世界与时代）　|　核心词汇：world　|　正文 316 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 world 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My grandmother never left the county, and she knew the ① world better than my father, who had been ② all over the world twice and could not find his way across the village.

Her ③ world was eleven streets, the shop, and the field behind the church, and she said a person who has not been further has no idea how much there is in eleven streets, and the world is bigger than the paper. The ④ world of the paper, meaning the one written about in it, was a different place entirely: eleven columns of things that never happened to anybody she knew.

She said the ⑤ world is not getting worse and not getting better, it is only getting longer, which my mother wrote down and which I have never been able to improve on. The ⑥ world of business, as my father called his, closed in 1974, reopened in 1979 and closed again in 1989, and she followed all of it from the same chair.

There is a ⑦ world of difference between knowing about a thing and having it happen to you, and she said so in 1961, and I have been forty-one years finding out that she was right. In 1971 she ate an orange from somewhere she could not pronounce and said it was ⑧ out of this world, and that is the only time I ever heard her use a phrase out of the paper.

The ⑨ world, meaning the one outside the county, came to the village in 1989 in the form of eleven houses and a road, and she said it had been coming for thirty-one years and had taken its time. The ⑩ world I have, and I have travelled further than she did, is smaller than hers, and no world, she said, is bigger than eleven streets, and I have known that since 1998 and have not been able to do anything about it.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. （某一特定的）世界；领域；界
C. n. 世间；世道；世情
D. n. （个人的）生活圈子；天地
E. 固定搭配：all over the world 全世界；世界各地
F. 固定搭配：the world of ... ……的世界；……界
G. 固定搭配：a world of difference 天壤之别；截然不同
H. 固定搭配：out of this world 好极了；非凡的

items.q: she knew the world better than my father
who had been all over the world twice
The world of the paper, meaning
She said the world is not getting worse
The world of business, as my father
There is a world of difference
it was out of this world
The world, meaning the one outside
The world I have, and I have travelled

answers.why: the world 意为“世界、天下”，祖母从未出过那个郡，却比我父亲更懂这个世界。
all over the world 意为“全世界、世界各地”，我父亲去过世界各地两次，却在村子里迷路。
her world 意为“她的生活圈子、她的天地”，她的天地就是十一条街、那家店和教堂后面那块地。
the world of the paper 意为“报纸里的那个世界、那个领域”，那完全是另一个地方。
the world 意为“世间、世道”，她说这个世道没有变好也没有变坏，只是变长了。
the world of business 意为“商界、生意场”，我父亲所谓的生意场 1974 年关门，1979 年重开，1989 年又关了。
a world of difference 意为“天壤之别、截然不同”，知道一件事和这件事发生在你身上，有着天壤之别。
out of this world 意为“好极了、非凡的”，1971 年她吃了一个橘子，说它好得不得了。
the world 意为“（郡外的那个）世界”，1989 年它以十一栋房子和一条路的形式来到了村里。
the world 意为“（我所拥有的）世界、天地”，我所拥有的天地比她的更小。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 祖母从未出过那个郡，却比我父亲更懂这个世界。（world）
我父亲去过世界各地两次，却在村子里迷路。（all over the world）
她的天地就是十一条街、那家店和教堂后面那块地。（world）
报纸里的那个世界完全是另一个地方：十一栏都是她认识的人从未遇到过的事。（the world of）
知道一件事和这件事发生在你身上，有着天壤之别。（a world of difference）
1971 年她吃了一个橘子，说它好得不得了。（out of this world）
answers: My grandmother never left the county, and she knew the world better than my father.
My father had been all over the world twice and could not find his way across the village.
Her world was eleven streets, the shop, and the field behind the church.
The world of the paper was a different place entirely: eleven columns of things that never happened to anybody she knew.
There is a world of difference between knowing about a thing and having it happen to you.
In 1971 she ate an orange and said it was out of this world.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 world 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: My grandmother never left the county, and she knew the world better than my father, who had been all over the world twice.
Her world was eleven streets, the shop and the field behind the church, and the world of the paper was a different place entirely.
She said the world is not getting worse and not getting better, only longer.
The world of business, as my father called his, closed in 1974 and again in 1989, and she followed all of it from the same chair.
There is a world of difference between knowing about a thing and having it happen to you, and in 1971 she said the orange was out of this world.
The world came to the village in 1989 as eleven houses and a road, and the world I have is smaller than hers.
